snippet.title: Into the Slimy Mines - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
A roguelike tower defence with a card twist! Protect your mine and rescue your crew after crash landing on a slime infested moon. Buy cards and booster packs, expand your tunnels, find crazy combos and squish those frackin’ slimes. Dig, build defend – and get off this B&*@!n Moon! 

Play Into the Slimy Mines in the February Steam Next Fest!

Wishlist Now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3639440

Coming May 2026 to PC, PS5, Series X|S and Nintendo Switch. 

Developed by Ant Workshop.
Published by Wales Interactive.
